title: Balloon Refinance Window, Term, Rate and History Limits — Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tiers
content:
When the balloon of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is refinanced, the tier supplies the window in which a refinance may be requested and completed, the longest refinance term, the refinance APR before any relationship reduction, the late-charge history limit and the relationship rate reduction.

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days before the maturity date from which a refinance may be requested | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Calendar days after the maturity date through which a refinance may still be completed | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Longest refinance term (months) | 24 | 36 | 36 | 48 | 48 | 60 |
| Refinance APR before any relationship reduction (percent) | 13.49 | 11.49 | 9.74 | 7.99 | 6.99 | 6.24 |
| Late charges allowed in the 12 calendar months before the request (maximum) | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Relationship rate reduction for a customer with another current Kestrel account (percentage points) | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 |

## Notes

- The refinance APR is stated in percent; the relationship reduction is stated in percentage points subtracted from that APR.
- A limit of 0 late charges, as on Tier 5, means any late charge in those 12 months exceeds the limit.
